# Achraf Ben Abdallah — AI Engineer in Tunis, Tunisia

> Achraf Ben Abdallah (also written Ashref) is a full-stack AI engineer based in Tunis, Tunisia. He builds agentic AI systems, retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, high-performance Go microservices, and resilient cloud deployment platforms on AWS and Azure. He is 4x Microsoft Certified and has delivered 20+ production projects.

This is the official personal portfolio of Achraf Ben Abdallah. Contact: hi@achraf.tn

## Profile

- [Portfolio home](https://achraf.tn/): Overview of who Achraf is, what he builds, and how to reach him.
- [About](https://achraf.tn/#about): Background, certifications, and the technologies he works with day to day — Python, Go, Next.js, AWS, Azure, Docker, PostgreSQL, agentic AI.
- [Experience](https://achraf.tn/#experience): Professional history, currently AI Engineer at Lameh AI, previously Software Engineer at HeloSolutions and Bookme OÜ, and Solutions Developer at Forvia.
- [Services](https://achraf.tn/#services): Cloud, backend, and frontend engineering services.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://achraf.tn/assets/resume_ashref.pdf): Full curriculum vitae.

## Free downloads

- [iPhone wallpapers — The Blueprint Pack](https://achraf.tn/wallpapers): 21 original iPhone wallpapers designed by Achraf, free to download individually with no signup. Each is a technical drafting grid over a soft gradient, carrying one typeset line. Exported at 1572 × 3408 pixels for iPhone 16 and every recent model.
